tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find a product across brands that sell on Shopify, with the seller named and the brand's own official store flagged — what a plain product search cannot tell you. Every result carries product_id, product_url, price per option and stock. Examples: "magnesium powders with third-party testing", "offici

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One listing in full: the price of every option, stock, the seller, whether that seller is the brand's own official store, and the seller's policy links. Use product_id from search_products. Don't construct URLs. Examples: "what every size of the FreeSip costs", "is this sold by the brand itself".

tools.name: get_return_policy
tools.description: The seller's own return terms — window, condition, opened items, who pays return shipping — quoted as the exact sentences of the policy that applies to this listing, not a generic template. Examples: "can I return opened supplements", "return window for a stroller".

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Who else sells this exact item, each priced for the same option — matched on Shopify catalog id or barcode, so a cheaper seller is a real match rather than a lookalike. Resellers are labelled and similar listings are kept apart from price matches. Pass variant_id (from get_product) for a multi-optio

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: A product passport: the brand's own listing, then every other store found carrying it, each marked same item, likely same, other version, bundle or accessory, with the evidence for that call. This is the only place a reseller is identified rather than guessed. Examples: "is this seller an authorized

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands with a confirmed official Shopify store. Supplement brands are listed first, then every other category, each with its own store domain. Paged: returns total, next_cursor and a line stating catalog coverage. Examples: "which supplement brands do you carry", "beauty brands with official stores"

tools.name: find_health_products
tools.description: Products whose seller states a third-party testing or eligibility claim — HSA/FSA eligible, USP Verified, NSF, Informed Sport, GMP facility, ConsumerLab — matched against the seller's own text and returned with the claim marked seller-stated.
